name: Arcader
review:
Arcader is a 15-line retro sci-fi slot about mysterious alien monoliths and a sentient machine handing out cash and experiences. It's one of Thunderkick's quirkier early titles.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 1,600x cap and a 96.1% RTP. Best for relaxed play and fans of the studio's offbeat humour.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
